title: Operation Hazel
description: The SFO is investigating Self-Invested Personal Pensions (SIPPS) sold through Sycamore Crown Ltd, Jackson Francis Ltd, TPS Land, CLP Brokers or PFR Services, which were invested into storage pods.

details.body:
In July 2025, the SFO issued charges against six individuals, following an investigation into the transfer of £75 million in pension funds. In August 2025, six individuals charged with fraud and other offences appeared at Westminster Magistrates’ Court.  In a hearing at Southwark Crown Court on 30 September 2025 a provisional trial date was set for 5 June 2028. In December 2025, the parties were informed that, due to court scheduling, the trial date was set for 4 September 2028.
